[You know, in today's lecture, I only understood the attendance part. Everything else in English went over my head. I feel like I will fail this time too.]
Speaker B: Arey tension mat lo, tum nahi hoge fail. [Don't worry, you won't fail.]
Speaker A: Tumhare liye bolna bahut aasaan hai. Tum toh class mein confidently answers karti ho. Mujhe toh yahi samajhne mein time lag gaya tha ki rectangular ka matlab aayat hota hai. [It's easy for you to say. You answer confidently in class. It took me so long just to understand that rectangular means 'aayat'.]
Speaker B: Toh tujhe kya lagta hai meri English hamesha se itni achhi hai? Main bhi jab 10th standard mein Hindi medium se English mein aayi na, toh meri English bahut weak thi. Marks kam aate the aur sab mazaak banate the. Phir maine SpeakX app use kiya. [So do you think my English was always this good? When I transitioned from Hindi medium to English in 10th grade, my English was very weak. I got low marks and everyone made fun of me. Then I used the SpeakX app.]
Speaker A: SpeakX app! Par isse kya hoga Priti? English bolna seekhna hai, padhna nahi. [SpeakX app! But what will that do, Priti? I want to learn to speak English, not read it.]
Speaker B: Arey nahi, ismein AI teachers ke saath ekdum real conversation hoti hai. Jaise tum aur main baat kar rahe hain, waise hi. Jab bhi main galat bolti thi, woh durant correct kar deti thi. Isse mera vocabulary bhi theek ho gaya hai aur ab confidence bhi aa gaya hai. [Oh no, it has real conversations with AI teachers, just like you and I are talking. Whenever I spoke incorrectly, she corrected me instantly. This improved my vocabulary and built my confidence.]
Speaker A: Wow! Aur iska pricing kya hai? [Wow! And what is its pricing?]
Speaker B: Sirf  2 mai 7 din ka trail le sakte ho. [You can get a 7-day trial for just  2.]
Speaker A: Ab purana topper Harsh wapas aayega. Main abhi download karta hoon SpeakX app. [Now the old topper Harsh will return. I will download the SpeakX app right now.]
